i.n: stock cube, made up with 80 mL water

method.s: Heat some oil in a pan. Brown the chicken thighs in batches over high heat, 3 minutes each side, and transfer to slow cooker.
Heat some more oil in the pan, reduce heat to medium, add onion and cook for 10 minutes, stirring.
Add garlic and ginger and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes. Transfer to slow cooker.
Add oyster sauce, stock, soy sauce and caster sugar. Cover and cook for 1 hour 40 minutes on high.
Add the yellow and red capsicum and cook for a further 30 minutes.
Combine the cornflour with 1/4 C water. Add the mixture to the slow cooker and stir in gently.
Cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until sauce has thickened.
Toss the basil through and serve with steamed rice, topped with cashew nuts.
